title: MEA student demonstration against increased tuition and fees
notes: S053 is an April 16 advance report for the April 17 action; S052 reports that Saturday's march. Both Novo Jornal articles carry the same byline, Fernando Calueto, and describe the same MEA action/route, so they are related reports rather than independent corroboration. The body says students assembled/marched but gives no total attendance; four reported detentions are not turnout. No February physical continuity is evidenced.
